L=(a,b)=>state.lang==='en'?a:b;const icon=k=>({sound:'♫',pen:'↗',back:'←',check:'✓'})[k]||'';const persist=()=>{};const soundName=()=>{const p=soundPresets.find(x=>x[0]===store.soundPreset);return L(p[1],p[2])};const send=type=>window.ReactNativeWebView?.postMessage(JSON.stringify({type}));function toast(text){document.getElementById('home-status').textContent=text;}function openDialog(title,body,actions){document.getElementById('dialog-content').innerHTML='<h2>'+title+'</h2>'+body+'<div class="dialog-actions">'+actions+'</div>';document.getElementById('dialog').showModal();}function presence(){return `<section class="presence-view quiet-composition"><div class="presence-art" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="presence-center"><div class="presence-heading" ${state.immersed?'inert aria-hidden="true"':''}><h1>${L('Take your time.','不必着急。')}</h1></div><p class="presence-anchor">${store.anchor==='sight'?L('Let your eyes rest for a moment.','让目光，轻轻停一会儿。'):store.anchor==='sound'?L('Listen to what is already here.','听听此刻，身边的声音。'):L('A moment, just for you.','在这里，歇一会儿。')}</p><div class="presence-invitation" ${state.immersed?'inert aria-hidden="true"':''}><button class="quiet-enter" data-action="enter-presence">${L('Sit awhile','安静一会儿')}<span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button></div></div><div class="presence-dock" ${state.immersed?'inert aria-hidden="true"':''}><button class="presence-control" data-action="sound" aria-label="${L(audioSource?'Turn sound off':'Turn ambient sound on',audioSource?'关闭环境声':'开启环境声')}" aria-pressed="${!!audioSource}">${icon('sound')}<span>${L(audioSource?'Sound on':'Sound off',audioSource?'声音已开':'声音已关')}</span></button><button class="presence-express" data-action="express">${L('Keep this moment','记下此刻')}${icon('pen')}</button></div>${state.immersed?`<button class="presence-return" data-action="leave-presence">${icon('back')}${L('Return','返回')}</button>`:''}</section>`;}
function soundControl(){return `<button class="presence-control" data-action="sound-options" aria-label="${L('Choose a sound','选择静坐声音')}">${icon('sound')}<span data-sound-label>${audioSource?soundName():L('Sound off','声音已关')}</span><span class="sound-chevron" aria-hidden="true">⌄</span></button>`;}
function refreshSound(){document.querySelectorAll('[data-sound-label]').forEach(el=>el.textContent=audioSource?soundName():L('Sound off','声音已关'));document.querySelectorAll('[data-sound-play]').forEach(el=>{el.disabled=audioStarting;el.textContent=audioStarting?L('Opening…','正在开启……'):audioSource?L('Turn sound off','关闭声音'):L('Play this sound','开启声音');el.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(!!audioSource));});document.querySelectorAll('[data-sound-preset]').forEach(el=>el.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(el.dataset.soundPreset===store.soundPreset)));}
function soundOptions(){openDialog(L('A sound to rest with','听见安静'),`<p class="sound-intro">${L('Choose a sound. Leave a little room for silence.','选一种声音，也给安静留一点位置。')}</p><div class="sound-choices">${soundPresets.map(([key,en,zh,desc,descZh])=>`<button class="sound-choice" data-sound-preset="${key}" aria-pressed="${store.soundPreset===key}"><span class="sound-symbol sound-${key}" aria-hidden="true">${key==='breath'?'◌':key==='wood'?'◒':'◡'}</span><span><strong>${L(en,zh)}</strong><small>${L(desc,descZh)}</small></span><span class="sound-selected">${icon('check')}</span></button>`).join('')}</div><div class="setting-row sound-level"><label for="sound-volume">${L('Volume','音量')}</label><input id="sound-volume" type="range" min="0" max="0.3" step="0.01" value="${store.volume}"></div><p class="sound-footnote">${L('Starts only when you choose. Pauses when you leave.','首页声音默认关闭，可手动开启；进入庭院自动播放木鱼。')}</p>`,`<button class="secondary-button" data-action="close-dialog">${L('Done','好了')}</button><button class="primary-button" data-sound-play data-action="sound" aria-pressed="${!!audioSource}">${audioSource?L('Turn sound off','关闭声音'):L('Play this sound','开启声音')}</button>`);}
function stopSound(){audioStarting=false;if(audioSource){try{audioSource.stop();}catch{}audioSource.disconnect();audioSource=null;}if(audioGain){audioGain.disconnect();audioGain=null;}if(audioCtx){audioCtx.close().catch(()=>{});audioCtx=null;}refreshSound();}
function replaceSound(offset=0){if(audioSource){try{audioSource.stop();}catch{}audioSource.disconnect();}const {data,rate,duration}=window.CijianAmbience.generate(store.soundPreset,audioCtx.sampleRate),buffer=audioCtx.createBuffer(1,data.length,rate);buffer.copyToChannel(data,0);audioSource=audioCtx.createBufferSource();audioSource.buffer=buffer;audioSource.loop=true;audioSource.connect(audioGain);audioSource.start(0,offset%duration);}
function alignBreathSound(){if(!audioSource||!audioCtx)return;const phase=window.CijianMeditation.phase();replaceSound(phase.elapsed/1000);if(phase.paused)audioCtx.suspend().catch(()=>{});else audioCtx.resume().catch(()=>{});}
async function toggleSound(){if(audioStarting)return;if(audioSource){stopSound();return;}try{audioStarting=true;refreshSound();const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!AC)throw new Error('Audio unavailable');const context=new AC();audioCtx=context;audioGain=context.createGain();audioGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0,context.currentTime);audioGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(store.volume,context.currentTime+.35);audioGain.connect(context.destination);await context.resume();if(audioCtx!==context)return;replaceSound(state.immersed&&store.soundPreset==='breath'?window.CijianMeditation.phase().elapsed/1000:0);audioStarting=false;refreshSound();if(state.immersed&&store.soundPreset==='breath'&&window.CijianMeditation.phase().paused)context.suspend().catch(()=>{});}catch{stopSound();toast(L('Sound is unavailable in this browser.','当前浏览器暂时无法播放环境声。'));}}
function chooseSound(key){if(!soundPresets.some(p=>p[0]===key))return;store.soundPreset=key;persist();if(audioSource){audioCtx.resume().catch(()=>{});replaceSound(state.immersed&&key==='breath'?window.CijianMeditation.phase().elapsed/1000:0);if(state.immersed&&key==='breath'&&window.CijianMeditation.phase().paused)audioCtx.suspend().catch(()=>{});}refreshSound();}
let homeSlogans=[],sloganIndex=0,sloganTimer=null,homeActive=true,homeReduced=false;
function stopSlogans(){if(sloganTimer){clearInterval(sloganTimer);sloganTimer=null}}
function showSlogan(animate=false){const el=document.querySelector('.presence-heading h1');if(!el)return;const item=homeSlogans[sloganIndex];el.textContent=item?(state.lang==='en'?(item.en||item.zh):item.zh):L('Take your time.','不必着急。');if(animate&&!homeReduced)el.animate?.([{opacity:0,transform:'translateY(8px)'},{opacity:1,transform:'translateY(0)'}],{duration:900,easing:'ease-out'})}
function syncSlogans(data){if(Array.isArray(data.slogans)){const next=data.slogans.filter(x=>x&&typeof x.zh==='string'&&typeof x.en==='string').slice(0,100);if(JSON.stringify(next)!==JSON.stringify(homeSlogans)){homeSlogans=next;sloganIndex=0}}homeReduced=!!data.reduce;homeActive=!!data.active;stopSlogans();showSlogan();if(homeActive&&!homeReduced&&homeSlogans.length>1)sloganTimer=setInterval(()=>{sloganIndex=(sloganIndex+1)%homeSlogans.length;showSlogan(true)},10000)}
function stopHome(){homeActive=false;stopSlogans();stopSound()}
function render(){document.documentElement.lang=state.lang==='en'?'en':'zh-CN';document.getElementById('app').innerHTML=presence().replace('</button></div></div>', '</button><button class="quiet-enter unwind-enter" data-action="enter-unwind">'+L('Unwind a while','解压一会儿')+'<span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button><button class="quiet-enter read-enter" data-action="enter-books">'+L('Read the suttas','读经')+'<span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button></div></div>').replaceAll('↗','↗\uFE0E').replace(/<button class="presence-control"[\s\S]*?<\/button>/,soundControl()).replace(/<div class="presence-art"[^>]*><\/div>/,'<div class="presence-art" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="invelle-clouds" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>');showSlogan()}
window.homeNative=data=>{if(data.action==='background'){stopHome();return}if(data.action==='settings'){document.body.classList.toggle('invelle-still',!!data.reduce);if(state.lang!==data.lang){state.lang=data.lang;render();refreshSound()}syncSlogans(data)}};
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const el=e.target.closest('[data-action],[data-sound-preset]');if(!el)return;if(el.dataset.soundPreset){chooseSound(el.dataset.soundPreset);return}const a=el.dataset.action;if(a==='enter-presence'||a==='express'||a==='enter-unwind'||a==='enter-books'){stopHome();send(a==='express'?'write':a==='enter-unwind'?'unwind':a==='enter-books'?'books':'enter')}if(a==='sound'){if(el.hasAttribute('data-sound-play'))toggleSound();else soundOptions()}if(a==='sound-options')soundOptions();if(a==='close-dialog')document.getElementById('dialog').close()});
document.addEventListener('input',e=>{if(e.target.id==='sound-volume'){store.volume=+e.target.value;if(audioGain&&audioCtx)audioGain.gain.setTargetAtTime(store.volume,audioCtx.currentTime,.1)}});
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)stopHome()});window.addEventListener('pagehide',stopHome);render();
